title: Figora Warrior
description: A fierce female warrior with short silver hair and purple eyes stands in a dynamic combat pose. She wears ornate purple and white fantasy armor with crystalline accents, matching purple wraps on her feet and forearms, set against a textured grey stone banner with large dripping purple graffiti spelling FIGORA.
